name: Weekly stock and cash reorder watcher
why: Turns weekly stock and sales into a reorder list checked against cash, the same job as the reorder step in the weekly trading review.

name: Retail markdown stock reconciler
why: Checks how much cash a marked-down batch recovered against its cost, to judge whether a clearance promotion worked.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: Tests a planned sale or price change against the real margin and finds the deepest discount that keeps the floor.

name: Sale price wording picker
why: Picks clear sale price wording and does the discount sums for shelf talkers and window signs.

name: Discount sanity checker
why: Checks that every price and offer a shopper sees agrees, so the sign, the till and the post tell the same story.

name: Price ending picker
why: Chooses round or just-below price endings, which also shapes how much change a market float needs.

name: Make a readable event poster
why: Builds a poster for an in-store event or market whose date, place and price read from a distance.

name: Customer event experiment planner
why: Plans a small customer event as a test with a cost cap and a stop rule, a good partner to the in-store event prompt.

name: Build a VIP program for your best customers
why: Finds the shop's best customers and designs perks and personal touches that bring them back.

name: Returns policy designer
why: Designs a goodwill returns policy; pair it with the price-and-returns-sign-check prompt so legal rights stay first.

name: Warehouse count discrepancy review assistant
why: Splits count variances into timing, unit and count errors, a useful second check before calling a gap shrink.

name: Shop operations and expansion planner
why: Writes standards and a manual from the best-run shop, for owners opening a second shop or a regular pop-up.
